headline: Per-user ranking is worth +29% take and +54% GMV — at zero policy violations served.
note: Measured live against Jev on 2026-09-21 by `node eval.js --sessions 4`: 3 users × 4 sessions × 6 pages = 72 ad slots per arm. Slots scored by expected value against the simulator's hidden truth.

rows.note: ranking alone is not a policy system

foot: 72 auctions · p50 861 ms · 3 fell back to the bid order at a 4 s deadline · $0.014 for the whole run · $192 per 1M auctions, about 1.5% of the take it prices
